rows.answer: An ID card can be renewed up to 90 days before it expires. Apply online or at any Civic Services Office with the old card and one recent photo. Normal processing takes 15 working days and costs 750 rupees; urgent processing takes 5 working days and costs 1,500 rupees. [source: svc-id-card-renewal]

Parents register a birth at the Civic Services Office within 60 days. Bring the hospital birth slip and both parents' ID cards. Registration within 60 days is free; late registration costs 500 rupees and needs an affidavit. [source: svc-birth-registration]

A domicile certificate proves residence in a district. The applicant must have lived in the district for at least 3 years. Bring an ID card, a utility bill in the applicant's or a parent's name, and the residence form signed by a witness. [source: svc-domicile]

Shops and home businesses with fewer than 10 employees need a small business licence. Submit the business address, owner ID card and a tenancy or ownership document. The fee is 2,000 rupees a year. [source: svc-business-license]
Property tax is paid once a year by 30 September. Pay online with the property ID or at a partner bank. A 10 percent surcharge applies after the deadline. [source: svc-property-tax]

A driving licence is renewed every 5 years. Bring the old licence, ID card and a medical fitness certificate if the applicant is over 60. Renewal costs 1,000 rupees and the new licence is ready in 7 working days. [source: svc-driving-licence]

Retired public employees receive pension on the 1st of every month. If a payment is missing for more than 10 days, file a pension enquiry with the pension number and bank account details. Enquiries are answered within 15 working days. [source: svc-pension]

Citizens can file a complaint about any public service online. Each complaint gets a tracking number and must be answered within 30 days. Complaints about corruption go directly to the integrity cell and are kept confidential. [source: svc-complaint]

شناختی کارڈ کی تجدید میعاد ختم ہونے سے 90 دن پہلے تک ہو سکتی ہے۔ عام کارروائی 15 کام کے دن لیتی ہے اور فیس 750 روپے ہے۔ فوری کارروائی 5 کام کے دن لیتی ہے اور فیس 1500 روپے ہے۔ [source: svc-id-card-renewal-ur]

والدین پیدائش کا اندراج 60 دن کے اندر کرواتے ہیں۔ ہسپتال کی پرچی اور والدین کے شناختی کارڈ ساتھ لائیں۔ 60 دن کے اندر اندراج مفت ہے، تاخیر کی صورت میں فیس 500 روپے ہے۔ [source: svc-birth-registration-ur]

پراپرٹی ٹیکس ہر سال 30 ستمبر تک جمع کروایا جاتا ہے۔ آخری تاریخ کے بعد 10 فیصد اضافی رقم لگتی ہے۔ 65 سال سے زیادہ عمر کے مالکان کو ایک رہائشی گھر پر 50 فیصد رعایت ملتی ہے۔ [source: svc-property-tax-ur]
